instruction.thesis: The FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG short thesis was predicated on 67.52% annualized funding indicating crowded longs. The primary evidence metric gold_hl_funding_ann has collapsed from 67.52% to 12.88% — an 80.9% decline — within 2 hours of entry. The funding normalization that was the thesis trigger has largely completed. Meanwhile spot has moved slightly against the position (+4 pts, -0.09%). With the funding signal exhausted and spot not cooperating, the thesis is invalidated. The FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG setup family has avg P&L of -0.48% on clean live trades, and the blocked shadow learning shows the trend-block was correct in prior instances. Closing to avoid holding a short into a recovering spot with no remaining funding edge.
